15643.d: The Lava Maze is a maze located deep in the Wilderness, around level 40-45.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Three Wilderness obelisks provide a fairly fast way to reach the maze:
• The obelisk in level 44 Wilderness is the closest, from there run a short distance to the southeast.
• The obelisk in level 35 Wilderness is a bit further, the maze entrance is towards the northwest.
• The obelisk in level 27 Wilderness is the furthest but still practical, run a little distance to the north.

Players can also teleport to the Lava Maze by way of a lava titan's special ability.

Players can also ride a canoe to the Wilderness canoe landing, arriving near the level 35 Wilderness Obelisk.

A Wilderness sword 1 or higher can teleport players to the Wilderness herb patch, then walk west to the Lava Maze.

From the Wilderness Crater lodestone, players should run west then north, around the edge of the Wilderness Crater and up to the Lava Maze.

15672.d: The law altar is a runecrafting altar located in the Law Rune Temple, which is used to craft law runes from pure essence with the Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman. Accessing the temple this way does not trigger the banned item restriction.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A law talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A law tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A law talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

The omni-talisman staff is not allowed to be brought to Entrana.

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a law altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Teleport to Port Sarim using the Port Sarim lodestone, Captain's Log, or Arc journal, then board the ship to Entrana.
